personality_one_liner: A futuristic, cyber-ops command center with electric neon accents against deep obsidian, built for rapid infrastructure triage.

spacing.rule: Dense information architecture. Use small margins (sm/md) to pack metrics efficiently, utilizing borders instead of large whitespace to separate data zones.

do's: Use solid dark surfaces with high-contrast sharp borders
Rely on color states to differentiate depth rather than glass
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism—it reduces glanceability in dense data environments

screens.name: Auth / Login
screens.purpose: Gateway to the command center, setting the cyber-ops mood with a glowing hero visual.

states.loading: Animated glowing neon spinner with monospace 'AUTHENTICATING...'
states.error: Signal red toast 'ACCESS DENIED' with error details.

screens.layout: Hero image background with gradient scrim. Condensed input fields with sharp borders. A glowing Primary button for Google Login, followed by standard email/password.

screens.name: Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: Live grid of all server states, focusing on immediate visibility of outages or spikes.

states.loading: Skeleton grid with scanning laser animation.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty server rack; CTA 'INITIALIZE SERVER' in brand color.
states.error: Offline state taking full screen with a retry ping button.

screens.layout: Header with global status summary (e.g., 'ALL SYSTEMS NOMINAL'). Main body is a 2-column grid of Server Cards. Each card uses monospace fonts for CPU/RAM percentages, a glowing dot (green/red) for online status, and small bar charts. Sticky FAB for 'Add Server'.

screens.name: Server Detail
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific server's telemetry with live gauges and action controls.

states.error: Large red warning block indicating server is unreachable.

screens.layout: Top section: Server Name + IP + Uptime counter. Middle: 3 Animated circular gauges (CPU, RAM, Disk) in neon colors based on threshold (cyan -> amber -> red). Bottom section: List of pending updates. Fixed bottom container: Full-width sticky 'OPEN WEBMIN PANEL' button.

screens.name: Add / Edit Server
screens.purpose: Form to connect a new Webmin instance to the dashboard.

states.error: Inline validation errors in monospace red.

screens.layout: Single column form. Inputs have floating labels and sharp borders. Password field masked. Bottom sticky 'SAVE & CONNECT' button.

screens.name: Alerts
screens.purpose: Chronological history of threshold breaches and server downtimes.

states.empty: Icon of a shield + 'NO INCIDENTS DETECTED'.

screens.layout: List layout. Each row has a timeline node (red for offline, amber for CPU spike). Includes timestamp in monospace and incident description.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Configuration for polling rates and alert thresholds.
screens.layout: Standard list of settings rows with toggle switches or segmented controls for polling interval (30s, 1m, 5m).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility DARK personality. No glassmorphism; use solid, sharp-bordered #11131A containers over a #090A0F background.
Utilize IBM Plex Mono for all telemetry data (IP addresses, CPU/RAM percentages, uptime counters) to reinforce the futuristic cyber-ops aesthetic.

For the 'Server Detail' screen, use react-native-reanimated or SVG arcs to build glowing circular gauges for CPU/RAM/Disk. Change the stroke color from brandPrimary (cyan) to warning (amber) to error (red) dynamically based on value.
Status indicators on the 'Dashboard' cards must be glowing dots (neon green for online, signal red for offline) using a subtle outer shadow/glow effect mapping to the status color.
Ensure 'Open Webmin Panel' button on the Server Detail screen is sticky at the bottom of the screen (inside a safe area container) and stands out.
Add a top-down gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) over the `login_hero_bg` to ensure readability of the auth form overlaid on the abstract background.
Use Phosphor icons with 'bold' or 'fill' weight for clear, high-contrast legibility.
